_meta.source: SEAB SEC grading pages; MOE PSE pages for JC and MI, polytechnic, PFP, ITE 2 year and 3 year Higher Nitec, with their grade mapping tables
_meta.notes: Read from search engine extracts of the primary pages on 2026-10-27. G3 points equal the grade number by the O Level convention; no SEC page restating it was seen. Grades entered here are the student's own hypothetical targets, for planning and goal setting. They are never a prediction.

mapDown.note: A G3 grade counts at its G2 or G1 equivalent where a score is read at that level. There is no mapping upwards.

aggregates.name: L1R4
aggregates.plain: English, a Humanities, a Maths or Science, one more of either, and your best other subject, all at G3.
aggregates.bonus: Bonus points (up to 3) affect which college you are posted to. They do not change the cut off.

floors.label: Maths or Additional Maths at G3, D7 or better
Mother Tongue at D7 (G3), 5 (G2) or D (G1)

aggregates.name: ELR2B2
aggregates.plain: English, two relevant subjects and your best other at G3, plus a fifth subject at its G2 value.
aggregates.bonus: CCA can take off 2 points. Each course counts different relevant subjects; this uses your best ones.

aggregates.name: ELMAB3 at G2 value
aggregates.plain: English, Maths and your best three others, each counted at its G2 value.

dests.note: G2 grades 5 and 6, and a G3 9, cannot count.
Only with 2 or fewer G3 passes. With 3 or more, the score is not needed. Each grade counted must be 5 or better.

aggregates.bonus: No bonus points for PFP or Higher Nitec.

excluded.note: These grades cannot be used in polytechnic, PFP or ITE course requirements.
